description: SPGAL (symmetric pass-gate adiabatic logic): T-gate dual-rail networks with symmetric, energy-balanced charging (DPA-resistant by design); the per-cycle convention is definitional here
note: v89.8: overhead 2->4, self-load 1->2 per the published gate (Kumar/Thapliyal/Mohammad/Perumalla, Integration 58:369-377, 2017): cross-coupled PMOS M1/M2 + discharge pair M3/M4, two latch drains per rail; PFAL's convention for a 4-device latch. Owner-adjudicated 2026-08-09; clock_load stays 0 (M3/M4 are rail-driven).
